title: fix(mobile): Android fingerprint covers Expo native modules again
body: Play build 93 (2.0.0) crashed on launch with a missing `ExpoUI_TopAppBarView`. #19994 added that view natively in the `@expo/ui` patch, but the Android runtime fingerprint did not change, so production OTAs from #19999 through #20084 were published to build 93's runtime (`035e46c0…`). The Android fingerprint had stopped hashing any Expo native module. `expo-widgets` declares a Maven-resolved gradle plugin (`io.github.expo.peek.glance-fork`) with no `sourceDir`. `@expo/fingerprint` runs `path.relative(root, plugin.sourceDir)` on it, throws, and its `catch { return [] }` drops all ~56 `expoAutolinkingAndroid` sources. Build 93's stored fingerprint has 0 of them. iOS was unaffected. The bug is still present in `@expo/fingerprint` 0.21.5 and the current canary. Changes: - Patch `@expo/fingerprint@0.21.5` to skip gradle plugins without a `sourceDir`. Upstream fix: [expo/expo#51710](https://github.com/expo/expo/pull/51710); drop the patch once it ships. - Add a `Verify fingerprints hash Expo native modules` step to the production workflow. It runs before both the automatic reconcile and manual `mode=update` dispatches, and fails the job when a fingerprint hashes zero Expo native modules, so a silently swallowed sourcer error stops the OTA instead of shipping it. Verified locally (in `apps/mobile`): - Android fingerprint now has 56 `expoAutolinkingAndroid` sources, including `@expo/ui/android`. - Appending a line to `@expo/ui`'s `ExpoUIModule.kt` changes the Android hash, and reverting restores it. - The iOS hash is identical with and without the patch, so iOS OTA reach is unchanged. - Ran the guard step's script under Linux bash with `eas` stubbed to emit real fingerprints. Healthy Android + iOS pass. Build 93's stored Android fingerprint fails the step with `all` or `android`, and passes with `ios` only. Empty `eas` output fails closed. Merging changes the Android fingerprint, so Android needs a new production build before it gets OTAs again (the workflow cuts one). Build 93 has already been rolled back to the last pre-#19994 update (group `ce2c419c`, republished as `7d8cd43f`). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ---
head: 524a4b08b688a4637a749c5e7b596d75a0dd074f

files.patch:
@@ -234,6 +234,29 @@ jobs:
           MOBILE_BUILD_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile || 'production' }}
         run: eas build --platform ${{ inputs.platform }} --profile "$MOBILE_BUILD_PROFILE" --auto-submit --non-interactive --no-wait
 
+      # @expo/fingerprint swallows autolinking errors and returns no Expo module
+      # sources, so native changes stop moving the hash and OTAs reach binaries
+      # that lack them. Refuse to publish any OTA from such a fingerprint.
+      - name: Verify fingerprints hash Expo native modules
+        if: steps.expo-token.outputs.present == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.mode == 'update')
+        working-directory: apps/mobile
+        env:
+          EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
+          PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.platform || 'all' }}
+        run: |
+          if [ "$PLATFORM" = "all" ]; then platforms="ios android"; else platforms="$PLATFORM"; fi
+          failed=0
+          for platform in $platforms; do
+            # eas-cli prints an environment-loaded notice to stdout before the
+            # JSON even with --json, so discard everything before the document.
+            expo_modules="$(eas fingerprint:generate --platform "$platform" --environment production --json --non-interactive | sed -n '/^{/,$p' | jq --arg reason "expoAutolinking${platform^}" '[.sources[] | select((.reasons // []) | index($reason))] | length')"
+            if [ "${expo_modules:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
+              failed=1
+              echo ":x: $platform: the native fingerprint hashes no Expo native modules — OTAs and builds skipped" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+            fi
+          done
+          exit "$failed"
+
       - name: Publish OTA update (manual)
         if: steps.expo-token.outputs.present == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'update'
         working-directory: apps/mobile
